parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small lever or handle made of stainless steel, typically cylindrical in shape, attached to the faucet body.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle to adjust the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to open or close the water flow, providing smooth manual control.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main supporting structure of the faucet, made of stainless steel, connecting the spout and switch to the base.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the internal water channels that direct water from the inlet to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed body of the faucet.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved tubular part of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water exits.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the internal channel to the sink, often designed to minimize splashing.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to direct water flow in different directions.
